# anthropic_workspace_members (Data Source)

Lists the members of a workspace. Requires `admin_api_key` or `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_workspace_members" "production" {
  workspace_id = "wrkspc_01ExampleWorkspaceId000000"
}

output "production_member_ids" {
  value = data.anthropic_workspace_members.production.members[*].user_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace id (`wrkspc_...`).

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) Members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `user_id` (String) User id.
- `workspace_role` (String) Workspace role.
